globalRules.firstPartyConsumerRule: First-party systems consume SignalBus<T> snapshots directly; mods consume projected or copied mod-facing payloads only.

sourceSignalInventory.denyDefaultRule: A public C# ISignal struct is not a public mod subscription. It becomes mod-visible only when listed in allowedSignalBuses and backed by a bounded projection/copy wrapper.

requiredMethods.name: OnLoad
requiredMethods.allowedWork: subscribe events, register static/cold content, register settings
requiredMethods.forbiddenWork: resolve live player Transform/GameObject or mutate runtime simulation truth

requiredMethods.name: OnInitialize
requiredMethods.allowedWork: resolve supported hash-only world state and submit engine-owned requests
requiredMethods.forbiddenWork: cache Unity object references or native container handles

requiredMethods.name: OnUnload
requiredMethods.allowedWork: dispose HectonEventSubscription tokens and release mod-owned transient state

modLifecycle.versionRule: Loader rejects RequiredAPIVersion values newer than ModLoader.CurrentAPIVersion unless an explicit compatibility shim exists.

publicApiSurface.hotPathRisk: callbacks are watchdog-limited; handlers must not allocate or block
publicApiSurface.notes: Managed HectonEvent subscriptions are internal. Public subscriptions use unmanaged payloads, native byte copies, or projected DTOs.

publicApiSurface.hotPathRisk: mods must not poll this from unmanaged callbacks as a replacement for engine command authority
publicApiSurface.notes: No InputAction, InputSystem asset, or device object reference is exposed.
All writes are requests. Owning first-party kernels accept, clamp, reject, or delay execution.
Mods receive numeric resource ids, not Unity asset references.
Marker hash and scalar only. No strings in telemetry payload.
Registrations must not mutate authored ScriptableObject assets at runtime.

publicApiSurface.hotPathRisk: List<ResourceStack> is allowed only for cold registration
publicApiSurface.notes: Recycle overlays are official-owner inputs, not direct inventory mutation.
This is gameplay-affecting and must stay behind the owning manager.
Buildable catalog injection is not direct scene spawning.
Mods provide deterministic bias data, not live fauna handles.
Direct Unity asset references are intentionally blocked.

publicApiSurface.hotPathRisk: Dictionary<string,string> allowed only outside event hot paths
managed strings and delegates are cold/UI only
publicApiSurface.notes: UI claims must reflect engine acceptance, not assumed command success.

publicApiSurface.hotPathRisk: GameObject/Transform accessors are internal and throw
publicApiSurface.notes: Persistent prefab spawn/despawn is forbidden directly; use resource hashes plus commands.
JSON is acceptable here for mod-owned cold data, never as event transport.

payloadLayouts.notes: Required for every position-changing opcode. Dispatcher rebases at drain time.

loaderSaveAudit.runtimeBoundary: Loader and SaveState are cold-path/managed-boundary contracts. They do not authorize direct SignalBus, NativeArray, DataVault, Unity object, or first-party save-owner mutation.

eventSubscriptionAudit.lifetimeRule: Every subscription token returned to a mod must be disposed during IHectonMod.OnUnload; DisableManagedMod must isolate native, unmanaged, and projected subscribers by subscriber id.

allowedSignalBuses.producerMeaning: combat damage notification projected for diagnostics, UI, and non-authoritative mod reactions

fieldProjection.RelativePosition: CombatDamageSignal.WorldPoint minus current player runtime position
fieldProjection.Direction: CombatDamageSignal.Direction with finite fallback to float3.zero
fieldProjection.Flags: CombatDamageSignal.Flags plus low-tier sample flag when capped

securityNotes: No target component, Rigidbody, Transform, or damage receiver reference is exposed.
Mods cannot cancel or amplify damage from this event.
Finite guards exist in the projection job for position, direction, and magnitude.

allowedSignalBuses.producerMeaning: weather transition snapshot projected for ambience, UI, and non-authoritative mod reactions

fieldProjection.Scalar0: saturated WeatherChangedSignal.Strength01 with finite fallback to 0
fieldProjection.Scalar1: non-negative WeatherChangedSignal.FlowFieldScale with finite fallback to 0
fieldProjection.Flags: WeatherChangedSignal.Flags plus low-tier sample flag when capped

securityNotes: Mods cannot mutate weather authority from this event.
Weather hashes are numeric identifiers, not string event names.
Flow scalar is clamped before projection.
